metadata.description: Official plugin marketplace for ShiftOS — the education-first AI operating system program for destination marketing organizations.

plugins.name: shiftos-setup-coach
plugins.description: The ShiftOS Workspace guided setup. Run after installing your workspace: a twelve-step arc that builds all six ME/ identity files, personalizes your workspace contract, and quality-checks the result with one cold test. Session 1 companion; re-run anytime for targeted updates.

plugins.name: my-capture-system
plugins.description: ShiftOS Session 3 homework. A guided interview that produces your Capture Blueprint (visual one-pager) and a Master Prompt addendum. Re-run anytime to update instead of starting over.

plugins.name: role-os-interview
plugins.description: ShiftOS Session 5 homework. The fused expertise-extraction and Role Master Prompt interview: turns what you know about your seat into ME/role-master-prompt.md and ME/unique-abilities.md.

plugins.name: ai-ready-project
plugins.description: ShiftOS Session 6 companion. Run /ai-ready to take one real workflow through the AI-Ready Method's seven moves: produces the project brief (saved as the project's CLAUDE.md), a first draft of the deliverable, and a session debrief. Re-run in the same project to cold-test or tighten the brief.

plugins.name: myos-local-search
plugins.description: Give your MyOS Workspace a local search engine. Run /myos-search to install and configure qmd (a local-first full-text + semantic search CLI), build four collections that mirror the MyOS layers — workspace, meeting transcripts, past session logs, and outside documents — and wire the calibration layer and root contract so every session searches before it says 'I don't know.' Everything stays on the machine. Falls back to Grep when qmd can't be installed.

plugins.name: myos-heartbeat
plugins.description: Give your MyOS Workspace a heartbeat — scheduled, headless Claude Code work that runs while you sleep. Run /myos-heartbeat to set up routines (a 6 a.m. daily brief, inbox triage, pipeline updates) that run inside your workspace via cron on an always-on machine or a Claude Code on the web trigger. Drafts, never sends, by default; every run scoped and logged. The OpenClaw heartbeat, built on the Claude Code you already have.

plugins.name: myos-handbook
plugins.description: Write your MyOS employee handbook and make every session read it first. Run /myos-handbook to produce ME/handbook.md — success criteria, the cast, escalation rules, and a 'done' definition for each recurring job — then wire a hard-coded required read into the root CLAUDE.md contract (with an optional SessionStart hook for hard enforcement). The onboarding lesson that an AI colleague's handbook only works when it's required reading, made real.

plugins.name: myos-orchestrator
plugins.description: Run heavy, multi-source jobs in MyOS without overflowing the context window. Run /myos-orchestrator to execute the architecture that made an AI project manager reliable: a central orchestrator delegates to subagent fleets, data-gathering subagents dump raw source to local files instead of summarizing it back, and update subagents work from those files by path. The orchestrator never ingests raw data, so the context window stays clear and decisions run on raw source, not recaps.

plugins.name: myos-memory-session
plugins.description: Pilot teaching session — 'Give MyOS a Memory.' Run /myos-memory to learn the three-layer memory model (instructional, built-in, retrieval), reflect on what your seat most needs to recall, then install the local search engine via myos-local-search. The cohort lesson that wraps the capability. Pilot-stage: validate with a test run before cohort rollout.

plugins.name: myos-autopilot-session
plugins.description: Pilot teaching session — 'Works While You Sleep.' Run /myos-autopilot to learn how Claude Code runs headless on a schedule, the safety model (draft-never-send, least privilege, prove-before-schedule), and how to define a job before you automate it, then turn on one routine via myos-heartbeat. Pilot-stage: validate with a test run before cohort rollout.

plugins.name: myos-ai-employee-session
plugins.description: Pilot capstone session — 'An AI Employee on a Mac Mini.' Run /myos-ai-employee to tie the four MyOS add-ons (handbook, local-search, heartbeat, orchestrator) into a 24/7 AI employee: the five onboarding lessons, the management practice, the Mac Mini build phases, and the promotion ladder to chief of staff. Pilot-stage: validate with a test run before cohort rollout.
